retired: Historical pre-reset inventory only. See SYNCHRONOUS_CORE_BASELINE.md; the classified production native implementation has been deleted.
scope: Every defined function in the current bundled native translation unit; one primary responsibility per symbol. Mixed implementation dependencies are recorded in the group, not mistaken for ownership.

lifecycle.why: Runtime lifecycle and shared M/TLS accounting
lifecycle.desired_owner: private runtime, eventually Fishy orchestration over audited mechanisms

descriptor.why: Exact typed ABI validation and scoped invocation mechanism
descriptor.desired_owner: compiler-generated adapters plus narrow opaque runtime entry
descriptor.dependencies: codegen descriptor roots and exact layout

sync.why: Guard ownership, deferred releases, writer preference and CV association; OS calls are subordinate debt
sync.desired_owner: Fishy runtime policy over C platform locks
sync.dependencies: typed detach/drop, internal resource hooks, scoped guards

thread.why: Mandatory join arbitration, identities, wrapper/execution ownership and startup accounting
thread.desired_owner: Fishy runtime orchestration plus native thread mechanism

platform.why: OS synchronization, thread, notification, clock or stream write mechanism

completion.why: One-shot publication, subscriptions, producer authority and weak routing algorithms
completion.desired_owner: Fishy runtime using audited typed storage and M primitives
completion.dependencies: atomic check+subscribe, cleanup hooks, weak identity lifetime

channel.dependencies: typed detach, endpoint cleanup hooks, internal lock/wait, producer authority
channel.recommended_stage: ownership primitive demonstration before channel migration

executor.why: Service registry, FIFO claims, one runner, admission and shutdown policies
executor.desired_owner: Fishy runtime orchestration; frame ownership remains compiler
executor.dependencies: M/TLS, exclusive abort/dispatch pins, lifecycle registry

reactor.why: Timer heap/sequence and native operation command/envelope policy
reactor.desired_owner: Fishy runtime service over platform wait and external adapter
reactor.dependencies: reactor prohibition on arbitrary Fishy callbacks; native-only storage lane

workers.why: Fixed worker startup, reservation, dispatch loop and join orchestration
workers.desired_owner: Fishy runtime over platform thread primitives
workers.dependencies: attach/TLS and counted startup, shared scheduler

native_jobs.why: Native-only bounded queue/admission/mailbox/shutdown; physically in platform directory but contains policy
native_jobs.migration_required: separate from OS backend; no Fishy blocking lane yet
native_jobs.dependencies: finite native payloads, two-phase admission, reactor acknowledgement
native_jobs.recommended_stage: mechanical organization later; S16 only after its own gate

external.why: libcurl ABI/loading/options/callback/envelope interop or libc numeric conversion
external.desired_owner: external binding, with independent policy migrated out
external.dependencies: libcurl/libc locale, Linux loader, LLP64 ABI

growth.why: Bounded geometric accumulation/limit policy inside a libcurl callback
growth.desired_owner: runtime native byte collector pending a callback-safe storage facility
growth.dependencies: no arbitrary Fishy execution on reactor, fallible byte storage

http_policy.why: Public HttpErrorKind mapping from native failures

output_policy.why: Complete-write retry, newline and public output error policy
output_policy.dependencies: one counted write platform primitive, stable owned raw snapshot

platform_contract: extern uint64_t fishy_native_output_write (int32_t, const unsigned char *, uint64_t);

src/concurrency_abi.h.why: Exact typed descriptor and compiler/runtime transport; mixed primitive operations remain separately classified
src/concurrency_abi.h.migration_required: retain typed contract; do not expose as public FFI

src/completion_runtime.h.migration_required: implementation language may change; preserve one protocol

src/runtime/executor.h.why: Internal executor/task state representations; not a platform contract
src/runtime/executor.h.migration_required: separate policies from private representations with ownership gate

src/runtime/channel.h.why: Opaque transitional queue operation contract; public Result algorithms stay Fishy
src/runtime/channel.h.desired_owner: typed Fishy runtime/library plus narrow cleanup transport
src/runtime/channel.h.migration_required: yes after endpoint cleanup/typed detach gate
src/runtime/channel.h.dependencies: S12 fairness, closure, producer lifetime and typed operations

src/runtime_platform.h.migration_required: implement Windows backend later; no public semantic changes
src/runtime_platform.h.dependencies: host backend, shared M wait integration

compiler_owners.why: Typed compiler/runtime signature registry, checked intrinsic metadata; Channel op breadth remains debt, no queue policy belongs here
Typed frame ownership/suspension/finish and native factory adapters; no high-level queue/fairness policy
Managed allocation/header/atomic ARC/direct LLVM atomics; exact callable/value adapters and opaque handle representation
Exact evaluation/ownership, typed call/await lowering; formatting selection using snprintf is residual library-policy debt
Centralized Mobile/publication/provenance proof, never queue synchronization
Typed verified effects; no scheduler/platform semantics in public IR
Parsed prelude import registration/classification and visibility; no stdlib implementation algorithms
